description: This file defines kernel modules for the OpenWrt project, specifying module packages related to Lantiq hardware components such as the I2C controller and switch support. It includes configuration and dependency information, along with definitions for package descriptions and auto-loading details.

methods.name: KernelPackage/i2c-lantiq
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for Lantiq I2C controller, including title, dependencies, and default parameters.

methods.name: KernelPackage/i2c-lantiq/description
methods.description: Provides a description of the kernel support for the Lantiq/Falcon I2C controller.

methods.name: KernelPackage/dsa-gswip
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for Lantiq switch support, specifying submenu, title, dependencies, configuration flags, files, and auto-loading.

methods.name: KernelPackage/dsa-gswip/description
methods.description: Provides a description of the Lantiq switch support.
